facts.fact: 15 岁的 Valentina 一见钟情爱上一个已死/将死的英国飞行员
facts.anchor: Valentina Camilleri fell in love with him on sight, even though he was dead

facts.fact: 祖母 Agnes 战争爆发之初去世，全家因轰炸住进骑士团旧隧道
facts.anchor: She had died at the start of the war, and Valentina was grateful for the mercy of that

facts.fact: 家里开小酒吧招待英国飞行员，飞行员口袋里总备着给孩子们的麦芽糖
facts.anchor: The pilots especially were full of daring, and they always had barley sugar wrapped in waxed paper

facts.fact: 挚友 Gina Gerit 一家死于 2 月 Regent 电影院轰炸，Gina 被送去岛另一头的亲戚家
facts.anchor: Most of those killed were servicemen on leave, but there were some locals in the audience, including the Gerit family

facts.fact: 她的座右铭是不让德国人夺走她的希望
facts.anchor: I won’t let the Germans take my hope

facts.fact: 两家父母安排她在满 16 岁（9 月）后立刻嫁给 Falzon 家长子 Lawrenz，她不愿
facts.anchor: I don’t want to marry Lawrenz

facts.fact: 空袭警报响起时她独自留在 bastion 上不走，Robertu 先撤
facts.anchor: Every good sense told her to flee. And yet something was holding her back

facts.fact: 她目睹德机咬尾命中那架 Spitfire，飞行员跳伞落海，头垂着多半已死，她跑下 bastion 去救
facts.anchor: If her sight was serving her true, then his head was slumped to one side. He was likely dead
